milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task where the player must navigate to and visually identify the nether brick fence. The nether brick fences are placed at spawn-relative positions (5-8, 1, 5-8) forming the walls of a gazebo structure. The center target is (7, 1, 7). With max_distance=5, the player must walk approximately 5 blocks from spawn (which is ~9.9 horizontal blocks away) to get within range, ensuring meaningful navigation. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking at the fence structure.
